# Local rendering assets

KaTeX **0.18.9**, downloaded from the official npm registry using
`npm pack katex@0.18.9 --ignore-scripts`.

Package SHA-1: `60d720d8cc87a2267096785070e4210b39957bda`.
Only browser distribution assets, fonts and the upstream MIT LICENSE are included.
No install scripts were executed. No CDN requests are made by the workbench.
Rendering uses `trust: false`, bounded macro expansion and bounded sizes.

Upstream: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX
